svg.title: The envelope changes with height
svg.desc: A new comparable measurement of the five actual native tower meshes.
svg.text: Five measured profiles from the retained meshes. Common axes make geometric differences comparable.
Each profile is the maximum vertex radius within 80 height bins, doubled. The radial axis uses that stored mesh's XY bounding-box center. Height is normalized
Stored geometry only / vertex-bin envelope, not continuous section area / no structural performance ranking
